messages.subject: Re: SpectronauttoMSstatsPTMFormat throws error merging df and fasta
parts:
Hi Sudip,

As Klemens mentioned above, I believe this is due to the `fasta_protein_name = "uniprot_sprot_2022-01-07_HUMAN.fasta"` parameter. This parameter corresponds to the column names in the FASTA file you uploaded. The column you pass as this parameter must match the protein names in your PD file. I.E. if your  PG.ProteinNames column includes only the uniprot_iso id, then you need to pass ` fasta_protein_name = "uniprot_iso"` as the parameter.

Let me know if you still get errors after trying this!

Devon

parts:
Hi Sudip,

The `groupcomparisonPTM` function outputs three models: unadjusted PTM, global protein, and adjusted PTM. The unadjusted PTM and global protein are modeled independently, and the adjusted PTM model is the PTM model after accounting for changes in the overall protein. You do not need to process anything separately, MSstatsPTM will do it all for you. The manuscript goes into the methods and implementation in more detail.

The quantification function from MSstats will work, you just need to run it on the PTM and Protein separately (i.e. quantification(summary.data$PTM) and quantification(summary.data$PROTEIN)). There is no direct way to filer rows in MSstats, you would need to do a custom filtering to determine this.

Hope this helps!

Devon
